portability_note: validator.md prescribes npm-based commands (npm run list-endpoints, npm run list-tables, npm run code:analyze, npm run build, npm run lint, npm test, etc.). This target is a Python/FastAPI project (FastAPI + SQLAlchemy + pytest) with NO package.json and NO npm scripts. None of the npm commands are runnable here. Endpoints and tables were therefore derived by reading the source directly (src/routes.py, src/main.py, src/models.py). The Health Check in validator.md (package.json existence, npm install/build/test) is non-portable to Python projects and was adapted: source-path existence and direct source inspection were used instead. This portability gap should be addressed in the harness (stack-agnostic listing/build/test steps).

stage_6_security_validation.output: JWT (HS256) required on both feedback endpoints via get_current_user_id dependency; missing/invalid token -> 401; user_id taken from JWT 'sub' not request body; GET /feedback filters by user_id (ownership isolation). Secret is hardcoded (acceptable for test app).
